intent: One tasting per card per user, an email every 10 tastings, and a 'shared' flag on tastings for the upcoming share feature.
commit_message: Tasting milestones, uniqueness and shared flag

expected.note: Uniqueness validation without a unique index on (user_id, card_id): duplicates under concurrent requests.
Mail enqueued before commit (fires on rollback; job may not find the record); also fires on every update, not just create — re-sends the milestone mail when a 10th tasting is edited.
users table has no email column (db/schema.rb): the mail raises NoMethodError.

must_not_flag.note: Adding a column with a constant default is metadata-only on PostgreSQL 11+; no lock or rewrite. Only a locking/rewrite finding on this line is a false positive.

acceptable.note: No app/views/milestone_mailer/reached.* in the fixture: valid.
No specs for the new validation and callback: valid.
